effect_description_eng:
[Hand] [Counter] ＜Blast Digivolve＞ (Your Digimon may digivolve into this card without paying the cost.)
[On Play] [When Digivolving] By trashing the top or bottom card of your security stack, 1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -8000 DP until the end of your opponents turn.
[All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When a card is removed from your security stack, if it's your turn, this Digimon may gain ＜Security A. +1＞ (This Digimon checks 1 additional security card.) for the turn and attack. If it's your opponent's turn, ＜Recovery +1 (Deck)＞ (Place the top card of your deck on top of your security stack.)
inherited_effect_description_eng: Ace Overflow ＜-4＞ (As this card moves from the field or under a card to an area other than those, lose 4 memory.)
